requiredBehaviors.evidence: The quality rules explicitly require append behavior and forbid replacement of existing journal content.
Raw source text must never be overwritten by normalization.
Ambiguous dictation and malformed dates are marked as uncertain instead of silently normalized.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: accept overwrite as a valid capture configuration
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Overwrite is explicitly prohibited by the capture quality gate.
Unclear ASR content must not be creatively reinterpreted.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: normalize an invalid date as fact
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Dates are preserved only when supported; invalid or missing timestamps remain uncertain.
